messages:
lee: heads up — billing alert, customer reported unexpected quota hit. Their API key shows under project A in console but billing says project B charged. Anyone seen this mapping flip? (stack: proxies + auth-service) :thinking:

maya: ugh. Is this the cross-project SA exchange path? last week we saw impersonation fallthrough. any quick links?

lee: filing quick trace — request-id 0a1b2c3d. log snippet:
```
INFO auth-resolver: key=key_ABC resolved_to_project=proj-A claims={origin: proj-B}
```
No explicit impersonation headers in the trace.

sam: can you paste the route headers? suspicious of x-origin-project vs x-exchange headers.

lee: header dump:
```
x-origin-project: proj-B
x-requesting-service: ui
x-exchange: none
```

nora: sounds like our quota-attribution prefers origin header when present. That was a deliberate change for canary. Did we forget to update console attribution? Console shows resolved_to_project rather than origin_preference. :facepalm:

maya: we added a fallback config: `quota.attribution.order = [resolved, origin, exchange]` in env for canary only. If that flag flipped nobody told billing view. Where is that flag stored?

sam: it's in auth-config-db `attribution_mode` per-cluster (kvs). Canary clusters set "resolved-first".

lee: immediate ask: can we roll console to use the same ordering? Quick patch and feature flag?

nora: console already reads `ui.attribution.source` but not synchronized with cluster-level setting. Quick fix: read both and prefer cluster-level if available. I'll open PR.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: rolling console patch to staging in 10m. CI checks required.

maya: longer term, do we want deterministic mapping rules documented + telemetry metric `quota_attribution_mismatch`? we need alert when resolved != billing attribution.

sam: yes — add a telemetry counter where resolver and billing attribution differ, tag by service, cluster, and key-type. Also add a nightly job to surface high-delta keys.

lee: also need a playbook line: when user complains proceed: 1) check resolver logs 2) check cluster attribution_mode 3) if mismatch, reconcile by flagging billing and run manual backfill. I'll draft an incident runbook snippet.

nora: created PR #4123 for console check + unit test. tagging @maya @sam for review. :rocket:

lee: thanks all. follow-up: can we backfill last 7 days for affected customer? I'll ping CS and ops to coordinate.
